about: Talia Abreu is a solo esthetician running a one-room facial and skincare studio out of a multi-suite beauty collective at 2301 Del Prado Blvd S in Cape Coral (Suite 57), alongside several other independent aesthetics practices in the same building. Her LinkedIn lists her background at 'Beauty Ritual Facial and Day Spa' and training at the Florida Academy of Health & Beauty. She is best known for a buccal massage/facial technique worked both inside and outside the cheeks to lift and tone facial muscles, and for a tension-release facial aimed at TMJ jaw tension, performed with a weighted blanket for comfort.
about_source: Birdeye-hosted Google reviews (buccal massage, TMJ, weighted blanket details all come directly from named reviewers below) plus a WebSearch-indexed snippet of Talia's LinkedIn headline/experience.
alt_name_note: Several Google reviews (via Birdeye) refer to the business by a different name, 'Morning Dew' (e.g. 'I recently visited Morning Dew for a facial...', 'I highly recommend Morning Dew (Talia)...'), and the Fresha aggregator's auto-generated listing (sourced from Google Business Profile data) is titled 'Book with Morning Dew'. This suggests 'Morning Dew' may be the studio's Google Business Profile name or an earlier DBA, while 'Talia Abreu Aesthetics' is the name used in the task brief, on Instagram, and in Birdeye's own page title/FAQ. Since the relationship between the two names could not be independently confirmed (Google Business Profile itself was not directly viewable, see website_check), the site was going to use 'Talia Abreu Aesthetics' as instructed and would not have invented a claim about 'Morning Dew' being a formal alternate name.

reviews.name: Patricia Cazalvilla
reviews.text: I had the best, most relaxing facial. I would 100% recommend.

reviews.name: Katherine Pizarro
reviews.text: I recently visited Morning Dew for a facial, and I was absolutely blown away! The ambiance is calming, creating the perfect atmosphere for relaxation. The buccal massage is a unique experience I didn't know I needed! It felt like a deep-tissue facial that lifted and toned my facial muscles in a way I've never felt before.

reviews.name: April Mayle
reviews.text: Talia gave me the best facial I've ever had! I booked the tension release therapy for TMJ and I left feeling twenty pounds lighter. She's so knowledgeable on what she does and I will definitely be coming back for another treatment.

reviews.name: Jamie Lacey-Moreira
reviews.text: I highly recommend Morning Dew (Talia) for those looking for a way to rejuvenate their skin while also experiencing release of tension and stress. She creates a beautiful healing environment for her clients.

reviews.name: Hailey Burkhardt
reviews.text: Talia has created such a relaxing experience and tailors each facial to my areas of concern. I look forward to my appointments with her.

build_status_reason: No real photos of the business could be obtained through any accessible channel after exhaustive research (see images.source above), and the business's only known booking platform (GlossGenius) has been deactivated with no cached snapshot recoverable. The design system requires real, verified photography for the hero, about and gallery sections (never stock or invented images), and the mandatory site structure requires a populated gallery section. Building a demo without any authentic photo of the business would misrepresent it and violate the pipeline's core no-invented-data / real-photos-only rule, so no index.html was produced this session. All verified business facts (contact, hours, reviews, rating, service names, LLC registration, dead-domain checks) were still fully researched and are recorded above in case a future session gets unblocked network access to Instagram/Facebook/Google Images or the business publishes new photos elsewhere, at which point the build can proceed directly from this data.json.
